create-issue.note: Helper protocol and bundled Node runtime imports; caller owns content. No invocation of its callers.

create-skills.note: Reviewed CONTRIBUTING changes and candidate exclusions: maintainer map procedure is outside both extracted package-rule ranges. Read-only builder check confirms identical bundled guidance; existing runtime edges and provenance retained.
